description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for retrieving and transforming trailing dividend yield data from the Tiingo API within the openbb platform. It includes query parameter classes, data models, and an asynchronous fetcher with methods to transform queries, fetch data from an external API, and process the data.

classes.name: TiingoTrailingDivYieldQueryParams
classes.description: Represents query parameters specific to the Tiingo trailing dividend yield requests, extending the base query parameters.

classes.name: TiingoTrailingDivYieldData
classes.description: Data model for trailing dividend yield data fetched from Tiingo, with an alias dictionary for JSON key mapping.

classes.name: TiingoTrailingDivYieldFetcher
classes.description: Asynchronous fetcher class responsible for transforming queries, calling the Tiingo API, and processing the response data.

methods.name: TiingoTrailingDivYieldQueryParams transform_query(params: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts generic dictionary parameters into a specific query parameter object for Tiingo API requests.

methods.name: List[Dict] aextract_data( query: TiingoTrailingDivYieldQueryParams, credentials: Optional[Dict[str, str]], **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw trailing dividend yield data from the Tiingo API using provided credentials and query parameters.

methods.name: List[TiingoTrailingDivYieldData] transform_data( query: TiingoTrailingDivYieldQueryParams, data: List[Dict], **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Processes raw data from the API, applying limits and validation to produce a list of data model instances.
